preconditions.description: The number of computers n must be between 1 and 1500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= (n * (n - 1)) // 2 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: All difficulty values a_{i,j} must be within the range from 0 to (n * (n - 1)) / 2.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][i] == 0 for i in range(n)) and all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j)
preconditions.description: The diagonal elements of the matrix must be 0, and the matrix must be symmetric.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
All output integers must be non-negative.
All output integers must be less than 998244353.
